description_en: Queries the labels that are attached to one or more elastic scaling resources
description_zh: 查询一个或多个弹性伸缩资源已经绑定的标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun ess list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type scalinggroup --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Only scaling groups are supported. Valid values: scalinggroup
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，目前仅支持伸缩组。取值：scalinggroup
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The token that determines the start point of the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The resource ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 50
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key used to perform an exact search for Elastic scaling resources. The tag key must be 1 to 128 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

Tag.N is used to perform an exact search for Elastic scaling resources that have the specified tag bound. Tag.N consists of a key-value pair.

If you specify only Tag.N.Key, all resources that are associated with the tag key are returned.

If you specify only Tag.N.Value, the MissingParameter.TagKey error is returned.

If you specify multiple tag key-value pairs at the same time, only Elastic scaling resources that match all the specified tag key-value pairs are returned
fields.help_zh:
精确查找弹性伸缩资源时使用的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~128，N的取值范围：1~20。

`Tag.N`用于精确查找绑定了指定标签的弹性伸缩资源，由一个键值对组成。

仅指定`Tag.N.Key`时，则返回关联该标签键的所有资源。

仅指定`Tag.N.Value`时，则出现`MissingParameter.TagKey`的报错提示。

同时指定多个标签键值对时，仅同时满足所有标签键值对的弹性伸缩资源会被查找到。
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The label value used to perform an exact search for elastic scaling resources. The label value can be an empty string. Maximum length: 128 characters. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 精确查找弹性伸缩资源时使用的标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，N的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: value
